notes: Identity independently verified from supplied text: title matches Impact of APOE-ε alleles on brain structure and cognitive function in healthy older adults: A VBM and DTI replication study; authors Colleen Lacey, Theone Paterson, Jodie R. Gawryluk (for ADNI), publication April 18, 2024, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0292576, PLOS ONE 19(4): e0292576. Document is the primary research article web parse with Methods, Results, Discussion and references, not a preregistration or secondary report. Tables 1 and 2 have captions/links only; numeric table cells and figure contents are absent. No supplied PDF; no PDF pages available to render or verify p. 7. The replication locator is blank. The description covers multiple structural and cognitive outcomes, genotype contrasts and within-group correlations. Neither the description nor the available locators uniquely identifies the critical replication test. The original-side locator does not establish a replication test mapping. Candidate tests: GMV VBM comparisons ε4+ versus ε3ε3 and ε2+ versus ε3ε3 (p>0.05, TFCE corrected); FA and MD DTI comparisons for those two group contrasts (p >0.05, TFCE corrected); omnibus cognitive MANCOVA (Pillai V = 0.06, F(4,206) = 1.51, p = 0.20); memory and EF effects (printed η² = 0.035 and 0.037, with partial eta squared specified in Methods); within-genotype correlations of FA, MD and GMV with memory and EF (numeric Table 2 cells unavailable). No metric conversion or pairing of outcome-specific eta squared with omnibus p performed. Candidate sample evidence only: final 116 participants comprise mutually exclusive genotype groups ε2+ 17, ε3ε3 64, ε4+ 35. Participants with ε2ε4 or no APOE data excluded; 25 excluded for corrupted image quality; all ε2ε2 excluded in screening/preprocessing. VBM additionally excludes 9 ε3ε3 participants. Imaging uses two-group comparisons; cognitive MANCOVA uses three groups; correlations use individual genotype groups. Thus final whole-sample 116 is not assigned as analytic N for an unidentified test. No N inferred from degrees of freedom. No analytic N sum extracted. Unassigned fields are placeholders only. All assigned unfinished fields examined together; no assignment by row order or numeric matching.
